application: Focus SVT front knuckle to Mustang Big Brake Kit (BBK) caliper adapter bracket
caliper_spec: 2010 Ford Mustang GT Front Brake Caliper, Rotor (316x30 mm), and Carrier (Dual 43 mm Piston)

verification_status.v1_physical_test_fit: PASSED (Earlier V1 flat plate + 4.00 mm spacers confirmed hole centers and rotor centering)
verification_status.v2_1_physical_test_fit: PENDING_V2_1_FIT_CHECK (Enlarged V2.1 G1-tangent outline, Ø35.0 mm SVT bosses, upper bridge, and inner nut/washer/socket clearance must be verified on vehicle with full-thickness 9.525 mm V2.1 test print; 4 mm gauge only checks 2D outline/hole centers)
verification_status.structural_disposition: CANDIDATE_REQUIRING_FIT_AND_ASSEMBLY_VALIDATION (V2.1 STEP 6f570979... 3D FEA screening gives 0.0901 mm displacement and 242.4 MPa equal-load X bore peak, 368.8 MPa back-face peak, and 363.8-486.5 MPa under 75/25 load sharing; full release requires mill certificate, hardware/torque/preload validation, and carrier thread engagement verification)
verification_status.geometry_revision: V2.1 Exact G1-Tangent Profile (STEP SHA-256: 6f57097922f5a15efb3da27714a69521b6ecd68713ded26432cea28f97e3d3f5; 0.000000 deg tangent discontinuity at all 8 perimeter junctions; exact 11.000 mm inner and 12.000 mm outer ligaments; all 4 holes Ø13.00 mm through-clearance)

reversibility.side_compatibility: Universal (Driver Side LH and Passenger Side RH by flipping bracket)

spacer_specifications.location: Between adapter plate and Mustang GT caliper carrier

material_and_structural_specs.material: AISI 1018 Cold-Rolled Steel (ASTM A108; screening assumptions Sy=370 MPa, Su=440 MPa, E=205 GPa pending actual mill certificate)
